title: Software Engineer
description:
Hybrid with a flexible base location

London: £50,849 to £60,384 per annum

National: £46,885 to £55,677 per annum

Permanent - 36 hours per week - flexible options considered


This is a great opportunity to join our team, Employer of the Year Housing Heroes awards 2025 and Winner 2026 Inspiring Places to Work UK & Ireland

Are you a passionate Software Engineer looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a talented developer to join our collaborative technology team, where you'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful products, contribute to exciting projects, and continue building your skills across the software development lifecycle.

In this role, you'll work closely with Senior Software Engineers and Lead Engineers to design, develop and deliver high-quality software solutions. Whether your strengths lie in frontend development using React and TypeScript or backend development with .NET and C#, you'll be supported to deepen your expertise while gaining broader exposure across the technology stack.

We value engineers who are curious, proactive and keen to learn, with a genuine interest in creating applications that provide a great experience for end users. You'll be an active member of an agile team, contributing to code reviews, sprint ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives. Alongside hands-on development, you'll have the opportunity to work with Git source control, CI/CD practices and SQL databases, helping to deliver reliable and scalable solutions that make a real impact.

This position would suit someone with commercial software development experience who enjoys solving problems, working collaboratively and continuously developing their technical capabilities. In return, you'll join a supportive environment that encourages growth, knowledge sharing and career progression.

If you're ready to be part of a team where your ideas are valued and your development is actively encouraged, then we want to hear from you now.

Please review the full role profile and Behaviours & Mandatory Accountabilities on our website before applying.

Salaries are just the starting point. Here at Clarion we're dedicated to rewarding hard work and commitment, and providing benefits that support you and your lifestyle.

Not sure who we are and what we do? Click 'apply' to visit our website where you can dive in and find out more about us and the benefits we offer.

Closing Date:Sunday 6 December 2026 at midnight.   

This is a hybrid role with a base location offered at one of our offices across England.  Candidates may be expected to travel occasionally.  

At Clarion Housing Group, we support the responsible use of AI.  Please visit our website to view your guide to using AI during your recruitment process.  

You must be eligible to work in the UK to apply for this vacancy; Clarion are not able to offer visa sponsorship.  You are required to reside in England or Wales for the duration of your employment.   

Act now - apply today!  This vacancy may close early without notice.
